title: International Museum of World War II

services.name: YouTube VR Library
services.desc: Imagine a 360 degree immersive field trip to Pearl Harbor, Normandy, France, Bastogne, Belgium, or Italy. Don’t imagine it, let’s make it happen. Discover World War II’s most famous battle sites and events right from your classroom or the comfort of your family room. “Stand” on Omaha Beach or visit Pearl Harbor while hearing from the veterans there. “Wade” in the water. “Touch” the bunkers or sand. “Walk” onto the USS Arizona at Pearl Harbor or “into” the American Cemetery in Normandy or the Punchbowl Cemetery on the island of Oahu. Find your way through the forests outside Bastogne, Belgium. Also, view archival videos from those days that defined history and hear from the veterans there.

explain.meaning: Virtual reality: a headset puts you inside the game.
